title: 第3章 技能商店和进化树第4章 第一次进化与技能
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
夜幕如墨，万物归于宁静。鸟鸣已歇，唯有不眠的虫儿在黑暗中低吟。
他静候着，口干舌燥，心神不宁，但一想到那河畔潜伏的杀机，便强压下心头的渴望。
他的谨慎得到了回报，不久，一群食肉者悄然而至，在潺潺流水中畅饮。他几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛——那是一群狼，它们在月光下饮水。
他屏息凝神，藏身于灌木丛中，尽量让自己的呼吸轻如微风。突然，一阵轰鸣声打破了宁静，大地仿佛在颤抖。
他惊慌失措，四处张望，却见一群熊缓缓走来，几只大熊带着众多小熊崽，沿着布满石头的小径前行。
目光交汇，狼群向熊咆哮，熊也以低沉的吼声回应。
两群野兽对峙，谁也不愿退让。狼群愈发凶猛，嚎叫着，张开大嘴，向熊狂吠。熊则拍打地面，发出警告的低吼。
终于，一只狼按捺不住，向熊发起了冲锋。熊轻蔑地挥了一爪，将狼击倒在地。受伤的狼哀嚎着，动弹不得。熊发出一声长啸，狼群终于夹着尾巴逃走了。
熊妈妈带着幼崽走向河边，让它们饮水。她警惕地守护着，以防狼群卷土重来。小熊们在水里嬉戏，追逐游鱼，足足玩了两个小时。
森林再次陷入寂静，但他心中仍有疑虑。他耐心地等待，观察是否有其他生物靠近。幸运的是，他的耳朵暂时没有捕捉到任何声响。
他走向河边，大口大口地喝水。水刺痛了他的喉咙，因为他太渴了。他不顾一切地吞咽着，他无法优雅地小口品尝，他将头埋进水中，贪婪地吸取生命之水。
他能感觉到有目光在注视着他，但不知来自何方，也不知该如何是好。他应该将每道目光视为敌意吗？还是应该等待它们的行动？如果它们比他更快，他岂不是成了砧板上的肉？
他心中充满了疑惑，于是悄悄地靠近那只垂死的狼。狼对他咆哮，试图吓退他，因为它伤得太重，无法动弹。但他没有退缩，他盯着自己的猎物。他需要食物，但森林中的食物如此危险……他不敢再冒中毒的风险，如果能吃到这只受伤的狼，那将安全得多。
艾可小心翼翼地靠近，狼疯狂地咬他，试图吓住他，甚至咬死他。他开始计算狼咬的时机，然后扑向它的喉咙，想要结束它的生命。可惜，他只是一只弱小的狐狸幼崽，没能杀死它，也没能给出一个致命的打击。这让他大吃一惊，当狼锋利的牙齿几乎触及他的脊背时，他急忙跳开。
-1点生命值
牙齿擦过他，让他的生命值再次回到了1点……又一次。他对这只垂死的狼的顽强感到愤怒，但他自己也弱小受伤，无能为力……
艾可在附近的石头间找了个勉强能容身的地方，眼睛一眨不眨地盯着狼。
这种态度激怒了狼。它无法接受自己的尸体被一只无礼的狐狸幼崽吃掉！愤怒之下，它对着艾可低声嚎叫咆哮，直到精疲力竭断了气，这过程持续了好几个小时……
[恭喜您首次击杀！]
他……震惊？他不明白这怎么能算击杀。

[如果击杀只能靠力量和权力，那大多数蛇和其他有毒生物在这个世界就无法生存了]
突然，系统平淡地回答了他的问题，仿佛在跟一个白痴说话。
他忽略了系统能读懂他心思这一事实，为此感到非常恼火。难道所有系统不都应该对主人有帮助、有用处吗？！这是他第一次拥有这样的系统，可感觉和他前世的……游戏里的系统大不一样？啥是游戏？不管怎样，在动物世界里他也不是什么高手……
[您已升级。]
[您已升级。]
[您已升级。]
……
系统继续发放奖励，把一切都赐予了他。
[您展现了超越自身等级的英勇壮举！]
[系统奖励您称号：[英勇]]
[您是否愿意获取[英勇]？]
查看了效果后，他自然选择了是。
[您已获取[英勇]！]
[称号：英勇]
[为用户直接增加1点活力、力量、敏捷，每升一级增加1点活力、力量、敏捷。]
[####]
[您已获得[技能商店]的访问权限！]
状态系统
他感觉自己的头脑比以前清晰多了，现在能想得更清楚了。可惜现在不是磨蹭的时候，他回到狼的身边大快朵颐。
他费了好大劲才穿过狼的皮毛，但一激活[咬]技能，就感觉像是在咬非常坚韧的皮。最终，他总算露出了一点肉。

[咬：1级-＞2级]
他的咬合力升级了，他又试着咬了一口，这次明显更容易咬穿皮毛了，但他也注意到自己的耐力下降得更快了。不过，这似乎不是线性增加的，效果提升了很多，而耐力的消耗只是缓慢增加。
他嚼着粉色的肉。他还担心生肉会没味道，没想到竟然……不，是非常美味。
[获得经验值。]
绝对不是因为获得了经验才觉得美味，绝对不是！
content_en:
The night is like ink, and everything returns to tranquility. The birdsong has stopped, only the sleepless insects hum in the darkness.
He waited quietly, his mouth dry and his mind restless, but when he thought of the murderous intention lurking by the river, he suppressed the desire in his heart.
His caution paid off, and soon a group of carnivores quietly arrived to drink from the gurgling water. He could hardly believe his eyes - it was a pack of wolves, drinking water in the moonlight.
He held his breath and hid in the bushes, trying to make his breathing as light as the breeze. Suddenly, a roar broke the silence, and the earth seemed to be shaking.
He panicked and looked around, only to see a group of bears approaching slowly. Several big bears and many cubs were walking along a stone-strewn path.
Their eyes met and the wolves growled at the bear, who responded with a deep growl.
Two groups of wild beasts faced off, with neither one willing to give in. The wolves became more ferocious, howling, opening their mouths, and barking at the bears. The bear slapped the ground and roared in warning.
Finally, a wolf could no longer hold back and charged at the bear. The bear waved his paw contemptuously, knocking the wolf to the ground. The injured wolf howled and couldn't move. The bear roared loudly, and the wolves finally ran away with their tails between their legs.
The mother bear took her cubs to the river and let them drink water. She guards vigilantly in case the wolves come back. The cubs played in the water and chased fish for two hours.
The forest fell silent again, but doubts lingered in his mind. He waited patiently, watching for any other creatures to approach. Fortunately, his ears did not pick up any sound for the time being.
He walked to the river and drank heavily. The water stung his throat because he was so thirsty. He swallowed desperately, unable to sip gracefully, he lowered his head into the water and drank greedily of the water of life.
He could feel eyes on him, but he didn't know where they came from or what to do. Should he regard every glance as hostile? Or should we wait for their actions? If they were faster than him, wouldn't he be meat on the chopping block?
Full of doubts in his heart, he quietly approached the dying wolf. The wolf growled at him, trying to scare him off because it was too injured to move. But he didn't flinch, he kept his eyes on his prey. He needed food, but the food in the forest was so dangerous... He didn't dare to risk poisoning anymore. It would be much safer if he could eat this injured wolf.
Echo approached cautiously, and the wolf bit him crazily, trying to scare him or even kill him. He began to calculate the moment when the wolf would bite, and then lunged at its throat to end its life. Unfortunately, he was just a weak fox cub and could not kill it or deliver a fatal blow. This startled him, and he jumped away as the wolf's sharp teeth almost touched his back.
-1 health point
The teeth grazed him, bringing his health back to 1...again. He was angry at the dying wolf's tenacity, but he himself was weak and wounded and unable to do anything...
Echo found a place barely big enough to fit among the nearby rocks, staring at the wolf without blinking.
This attitude angered the wolf. He couldn't bear to have his body eaten by a disrespectful fox cub! In anger, it howled and roared at Echo until it died of exhaustion. This process lasted for several hours...
[Congratulations on your first kill! ]
He...shocked? He didn't understand how this could be considered a kill.
[If killing could only rely on strength and power, then most snakes and other poisonous creatures would not be able to survive in this world]
Suddenly, the system answered his question flatly, as if talking to an idiot.
He ignored the fact that the system could read his mind, and was annoyed by it. Aren’t all systems supposed to be helpful and useful to their owners? ! This is his firstHaving such a system for once, but it feels very different from the system in his previous life... in the game? What is a game? In any case, he is not an expert in the animal world...
[You have upgraded. ]
[You have upgraded. ]
[You have upgraded. ]
…
The system continued to issue rewards and gave him everything.
[You have demonstrated heroic feats beyond your level! ]
[The system rewards you with the title: [Brave]]
[Are you willing to obtain [Heroic]? ]
After checking the effect, he naturally chose yes.
[You have obtained [Heroic]! ]
[Title: Brave]
[It directly adds 1 point of vitality, strength, and agility to the user, and each level increases 1 point of vitality, strength, and agility. ]
[####]
[You have gained access to [Skill Store]! ]
state system
He felt that his mind was much clearer than before and he could think more clearly now. Unfortunately now was not the time to dawdle, he returned to the wolf to feast.
It took a lot of effort for him to get through the wolf's fur, but once he activated the [Bite] skill, it felt like he was biting into very tough skin. Finally, he finally showed some flesh.
[Bite: Level 1->Level 2]
His bite escalated and he tried another bite, this time piercing the fur noticeably easier, but he also noticed that his stamina was declining faster. However, this does not seem to increase linearly, the effect increases a lot, while the consumption of stamina only increases slowly.
He chewed the pink flesh. He was also worried that the raw meat would be tasteless, but unexpectedly it turned out... no, it was very delicious.
[Gain experience points. ]
It definitely doesn’t taste delicious because of the experience gained, absolutely not!
